sql: with t(tk) as (values ('KXYTVIEWSHIGH-MOR26NOV-7.5M'),('KXYTVIEWSHIGH-OLI26NOV-12.0M'),('KXBTC-26OCT3017-B78250'),('KXRAINLAXM-26OCT-3'),('KXRT-WIC-96'),('KXTESTMATCH-26OCT270430AUSSA-TIE'),('KXYTVIEWSW-TAT26NOV01-9.0M')) select t.tk, (select best_yes_bid||'/'||best_no_bid||' @'||at::text from incentive_market_snapshots s where s.market_ticker=t.tk order by at desc limit 1) ims, (select yes_bid||'/'||no_bid||' @'||captured_at::text from market_snapshots s where s.market_ticker=t.tk order by captured_at desc limit 1) ms, (select best_yes_bid||'/'||best_no_bid||' @'||captured_at::text from orderbook_snapshots s where s.market_ticker=t.tk order by captured_at desc limit 1) ob from t
